Removed relative to legacy: the entire live voice mode. Legacy shipped 2,432 lines of audio code - LiveVoiceEngine.js (233, speechSynthesis voice ranking, chunked speak with word boundaries), LiveAudioWaveform.jsx (254), LiveInterviewSession.jsx (1,691) and hooks/useInterviewMedia.js (254, getUserMedia + MediaRecorder). A grep of frontend/src for SpeechRecognition, MediaRecorder, getUserMedia, speechSynthesis and AudioContext returns ZERO hits, so microphone capture, speech playback and the waveform are all absent; practice is text-only.
